**Before you paste anything:** ESPHome logs and configurations carry
credentials and filenames. Redact `web_server` usernames and passwords, any
`secrets.yaml` values, API keys, and any filename from the card you would not
publish. If a filename is the point of the report, replace it with one of the
same length and shape.

If this is a security issue, do not open an issue — see SECURITY.md.
